description: List the live clan themes the user can post to — themes of the clans they own, moderate, or have joined (each with the user's role, the theme's brief, and when entries close). Use it when the user wants to post into a theme / enter a theme / share to their clan, then pass the chosen theme's id as create_social_post's theme_id. Free and read-only; themes that haven't started or have ended are not listed.
name: list_my_themes
title: List My Themes
